identificationModule.briefTitle: A Clinical Study of SHR-A1811 in the Treatment of HER2-positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic Biliary Tract Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open, Multicenter Phase II Clinical Study of SHR-A1811 in the Treatment of HER2-positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic Biliary Tract Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is an open, multicenter Phase II clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of the SHR-A1811 combination in HER2 positive patients with locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer.

conditions: HER2-positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic Biliary Tract Cancer
